api_version: v1 (unversioned in URL; descriptive .php endpoint names)

auth.notes: Web API key from account settings; treat as secret. Passed as ?y=<key> on every request. Many user-scoped endpoints (e.g. API_GetUserProfile.php, API_GetUserProgress.php, API_GetGameInfoAndUserProgress.php) additionally require the target username via ?u=<username> — NOT ?z= as suggested; RA's actual query key is 'u'. Game-only endpoints (GetGame, GetGameExtended, GetConsoleIDs, GetGameList) need only 'y'. The client must support optional 'u' alongside 'y' per-call.

Game.endpoint: API_GetGameList.php (list by console) / API_GetGame.php (single, by game id) / API_GetGameExtended.php

Achievement.endpoint: part of API_GetGameExtended.php response (Achievements object, keyed by achievement ID)

endpoints_relevant_to_v1.purpose: Basic game metadata + image paths (RA Game Info)
Full game metadata + Achievements object with BadgeName per achievement (RA Game Info / RA Badges)
List games for a console, with hashes (Ingest)

image_resolution_rule: API image path fields (e.g. '/Images/067895.png', BadgeName) are relative; resolve game images via https://i.retroachievements.org/Images/{id}.png and achievement badges via https://i.retroachievements.org/Badge/{BadgeName}.png. Confirmed 'i.retroachievements.org' is the correct media CDN host (not 'media.retroachievements.org' — that domain was not found in official docs or source).
notes: retroachievements.org/API/ returns Cloudflare 403 to automated fetches (site-side bot protection) — discovery instead used the official api-docs.retroachievements.org site (via search + raw GitHub source at github.com/RetroAchievements/api-docs) and the RAWeb source repo. This does not block runtime API calls (Phase 7 uses the real API key + httpx, not this browser), only doc scraping.
